verdict.rationale: CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for an LLM inference engine like vLLM, but nothing in the evidence pack documents offloading weights or layers to CPU memory to exceed VRAM. The related evidence covers other features: quantization shrinks the memory footprint, CPU support means running entirely on CPU, and multi-GPU parallelism splits across GPUs. None of these is combined CPU+GPU offload, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
